findings.title: No Authentication on Any Endpoint — Full Anonymous CRUD
findings.remediation: Add JWT authentication middleware (express-jwt) before all /api/* routes. Implement RBAC distinguishing read consumers from write/dispatch/approve operators. Add HMAC signature validation on intake endpoints. Restrict /metrics to allowlisted IPs.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via Unauthenticated Force-Approve
findings.remediation: Require admin RBAC on force-approve endpoint. Validate item is in a state permitting approval. Enforce minimum vote threshold. Gate overrideRoute parameter behind admin privilege. Validate overrideRoute against strict enum.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Pipeline Injection — Full Pipeline Takeover in 4 HTTP Calls
findings.remediation: Require authentication + admin authorization on POST /api/cycles. Validate referenced work item is in a legitimate approved state. Add allowlist of items that can be included in a cycle.

findings.title: No Pagination Ceiling — Full Dataset Enumeration in One Request
findings.remediation: Add const safeLimit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20, 100) in all list route handlers. Reject non-positive values. Return X-Total-Count header for pagination.

findings.title: Soft-Delete IDOR — Deleted Item UUID Leaks, Victim Permanently Blocked
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, remove all blocked_by references to the deleted item across dependent work items. Add purgeWorkItem hard-delete operation.

findings.title: Stored XSS — Script Payloads Stored Verbatim in Title and Description
findings.remediation: Strip HTML at write time using isomorphic-dompurify or validator.js escape(). Add Content-Security-Policy via Helmet. Enforce max-length on all free-text fields.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /metrics Endpoint — Internal Telemetry Exposed
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to Prometheus scraper IP allowlist, or add HTTP Basic auth before the route.

findings.title: Webhook Intake Lacks HMAC Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Verify X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 against ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET and INTAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env vars before processing any intake payload.

findings.title: Assessment Pod Bypassed via overrideRoute Parameter
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute against strict enum. Require admin privilege to use this parameter. Reject unknown values with HTTP 400.

findings.title: Intake Routes Accept Unvalidated Enum Values (type, priority)
findings.remediation: Add Zod/Joi schema validation on all intake payloads. Reject with HTTP 422 if type or priority is not in defined enum.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at a reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Add HSTS header via Helmet. Redirect all HTTP to HTTPS.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Log Events (SOC2 CC7.1)
findings.remediation: Create an auditLogger with structured event fields. Emit login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition, data_export events from middleware and workflow handlers.

findings.title: Empty Search Query Dumps Full Dataset Across All Entity Types
findings.remediation: Require non-empty search query. Cap search results at 100. Require authentication before any search endpoint.

findings.title: NeedsClarification Silently Collapses to Rejected — Unauthorized Cascade Dispatch
findings.remediation: Clarify intent: NeedsClarification should halt dispatch and notify the requester, not silently fall through to Rejected. Add explicit state guard and audit log event.

findings.title: In-Memory Store Returns Live Object References — Race Condition on changeHistory
findings.remediation: Return deep clones (structuredClone or spread) from all store getter functions. Never expose mutable references to internal store state.

findings.title: Arbitrary String Accepted as overrideRoute Without Enum Guard
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute against strict enum before storage. Reject unknown values with HTTP 400.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers — No Helmet.js
findings.remediation: Add import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet()); as first middleware in app.ts. Configure strict Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: <iframe> Missing sandbox Attribute in DebugPortalPage
findings.remediation: Add sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin' attribute to the iframe element. Review if allow-same-origin is required.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint — Intake Flood / DoS Possible
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit globally. Apply tighter limits on /api/intake/* routes. Cap pagination limit parameter at 100.

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.remediation: Add cors middleware with explicit origin allowlist: app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(','), credentials: true })).

findings.title: No Hard-Delete / Purge — GDPR Art. 17 Right to Erasure Unimplementable
findings.remediation: Add purgeWorkItem(id) that calls items.delete(id). Expose privileged DELETE /api/work-items/:id/purge (admin-only once auth exists). Document data lifecycle policy.

findings.title: No Server-Side Input Sanitization on Free-Text Fields (Defence-in-Depth Gap)
findings.remediation: Sanitize HTML from free-text inputs using isomorphic-dompurify before storing. Add Content-Security-Policy as defence-in-depth.

findings.title: Raw err.message in HTTP 500 Responses / Stack Traces Shipped to Log Aggregators
findings.remediation: Log stack traces only at debug level or under NODE_ENV !== 'production' guard. In production emit only error message and correlation ID.

findings.title: No Max-Length Validation on Free-Text Fields
findings.remediation: Add max-length constraints (e.g., title: 255, description: 4096) on all free-text fields via schema validation middleware.

findings.title: No Request Correlation / Trace IDs in Logs — Incident Reconstruction Impossible
findings.remediation: Add request-ID middleware generating UUID per request, stored in AsyncLocalStorage. Inject into every logger call. Propagate W3C traceparent header.

findings.title: pino Listed in package.json but Unused — Unnecessary Supply-Chain Surface
findings.remediation: Either migrate utils/logger.ts to use pino (recommended — gains async I/O, child loggers, built-in redact), or remove pino from package.json.
